moments.author: Tom Warren
moments.quote: Xbox is launching a new film and TV division. It's called “XP,” a play on Experience Points, and it will focus on film, TV, products, live events, and partnerships
moments.why: This post sparked conversation because it signaled Xbox’s major strategic shift into entertainment beyond gaming, exciting both gamers and media industry observers.

moments.quote: Sean "Diddy" Combs' prison time has been extended. The rapper's release date was pushed back from Jan. 21, 2028 to March 8, 2028, according to Bureau of Prisons (BOP) records viewed by E! News.
